question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**late**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Late**" means after the expected or usual time.
 
• The sentence implies that the activity was not done on time.
